title: Moment from a Shear Diagram
statement: A solver reports shear v at stations x along a member, and moment is the running integral of shear. Return the moment at every station, taking the moment at the first station as zero and integrating between stations with the trapezoidal rule. The stations are increasing but NOT evenly spaced, which is what a mesh refined near the supports looks like.
constraints: the first returned value is always 0
hints: The area under the shear between two stations is a trapezoid: the average of the two shear values times the distance between them.
Assuming a constant station spacing is the mistake to avoid. Take the spacing from the x values every step.
Carry a running total rather than re-summing from the start at each station, which turns an O(n^2) loop into a single pass - the same prefix-sum idea, over a non-uniform grid.
complexity: O(n) time, O(n) space for the result

cases.name: uniformly loaded simple span: moment closes back to zero
